camel_example: aliyun devops GET /organization/5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx/workitems/workflow/listWorkflowStatus --region cn-hangzhou --spaceType Project --spaceIdentifier '例：5e70xxxxxxcd000xxxxe96' --workitemCategoryIdentifier Req --workitemTypeIdentifier '例：5e7xxxxb3cd3711dd6xxx2c' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Obtain the List of pipeline statuses for work items
description_zh: 获取工作项工作流状态列表
name: ListWorkItemWorkFlowStatus

parameters.description_en: The enterprise identifier, also known as the enterprise ID, is a string that can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】.

parameters.description_en: Work item category. Use "Req" for requirements, "Bug" for bugs, "Task" for jobs, and "Risk" for threats.
